QF.id: SIA Social Stock Exchange Introduction and Instruments_38

question.text: Of the seven Social Stock Exchanges set up globally before India, how many are still functioning as per Chapter 2, and in which countries?

answer.text: Five — Brazil, South Africa, Canada, Singapore and Jamaica.

explanation.text: The Logic: Per p.51 of the workbook, three out of the seven Social Stock Exchanges that were set up still survive and function, and they are based in Canada, Singapore and Jamaica. The Trap: Option A over-counts. Option C is simply wrong. Option D under-counts by excluding Canada and Jamaica. Note: The workbook's wording on p.51 — three of seven survive, in Canada, Singapore and Jamaica — is the source. The reasons individual defunct exchanges ceased are not stated on this page; do not infer beyond the workbook.
